violations.text: The non-food contact surfaces of the mixer and the ice machine have an accumulation of black debris. The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2025
